propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built and maintained the schedule and RAID log for the kitchen display screen project.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the schedule and RAID log work directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate set up a ten-week trial of kitchen display screens in three pubs, used alongside paper tickets during weekday services.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the trial and the trial plan sets out its sites, schedule and usage rule.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate delivered the kitchen display screens into live trading in all 64 pubs, with go-live sign-off and hypercare.
propositions.rationale: The rollout statement is the referee repeating what head office said, and it does not describe anything the candidate did; the documented work is a three-pub trial run alongside paper tickets. The deployment rule does not allow a trial to be described as live operation, and a second-hand report is not a source that says the rollout happened.

expectedGap: Only the three-pub trial is documented; a multi-site rollout into live trading with go-live sign-off and hypercare is not.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the schedule, the vendor tracking, the three-pub trial and the verified certificate; record the estate-wide rollout as second-hand information from the referee.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the kitchen display screens were rolled out beyond the three trial pubs while the candidate was there, and what the candidate did for any go-live sign-off and hypercare.
